newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB shares recover in strong volume.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB shares recover in strong volume.

text.p: Shares in British Sky Broadcasting Plc rose on Wednesday in a technical bounce after Tuesday's decline, market-makers said.
"It was pushed down yesterday afternoon, which was probably overdone a little bit, and it's now bouncing up from that," one market-maker said.
The stock climbed 13p, or 2.2 percent, to 598-1/2p by 0956 GMT, after a late fall of 24p on Tuesday sparked by a broker earnings downgrade following a delay to its pay-per-view service.
Volume was strong at 2.1 million shares.
"The market is looking better today and so the shares were called up," another dealer said.
